annotations.title: List servers a metric feed could pull from

description: The connected servers this workspace exposes to you, with the id a feed needs. Their tools appear to you namespaced as `ext__<name>__<tool>` — call one directly to see what it returns before proposing a feed. A server the workspace has switched off for you is not listed and cannot be fed from here.
